# Stratum Reference Implementation

Optional SV2 builds use `noise_sv2` from
https://github.com/stratum-mining/stratum at revision
`d3a05cfa8b51c6923df81f42bdac7f76b2147830`.

The upstream component is licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0; copies are included
here. These terms remain in force independently of supryolo's first-party
license. Source and transitive dependency versions are recorded in
`rust/sv2-noise/Cargo.lock`.

Binary packages include locked dependency notices in `rust-dependencies` and
Rust runtime notices in `rust-runtime`, alongside the other runtime notices.
